subject: P7-G1: harness-scoped MCP tool list in stdio server (Codex create_task)
description: mcp-graph.js reads ZONOID_HARNESS and filters the advertised MCP tool list accordingly. Codex wiring advertises a create_task tool (writes stub file + calls /sync). Default (claude) and other harnesses see the current unchanged 34-tool surface. Ensures no MCP surface change for existing users.
